integrity: Geometric vertices and primary classification are sourced. Gaussian maxima, angular probability, and width statements are analytically proved and checked using an included standalone script. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical unweighted star cosmological polytopes in the standard orthonormal embedding are treated.
The exact ambient Gaussian support distribution is origin-dependent; angular measures and intrinsic widths are translation-invariant.
The half-normal width limit is asymptotic. Finite sampling is corroborative, not an infinite-dimensional proof.
Global bibliographic completeness and independent mathematical validation have not been established.
title: A two-orbit Gaussian angular law and half-normal widths for star cosmological polytopes
